name: Rudi Restchance
personality: He treats every save as a personal misunderstanding.
visual_intent: Tall pear blob, huge startled eyes, lips sucked inward; padded flat cap, burgundy goalkeeper collar, two enormous worn leather keeper gloves held open as if the ball has filed a complaint
biography: He treats every save as a personal misunderstanding. In HyperNorm he guards the laundry-room doorway and accepts only safe or unsafe deliveries. The keeper gloves are oversized because doubt tends to arrive in pairs; he lets children retrieve lost socks without checking their score. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er hält den Kasten sauber. Die Akten über die Gegentore sind verschwunden.

name: Vera Vorwärts
personality: She celebrates the attack before anyone has agreed where the goal is.
visual_intent: Short triangular splat with swept quiff, subtle lashes, delighted crooked three-tooth shout; cream lace collar, burgundy striped shoulder patch; proudly cradles one old stitched brown soccer ball
biography: She celebrates the attack before anyone has agreed where the goal is. Her building league divides residents into winners and obstructions. She keeps the old leather ball for its reliable seams, but has secretly been passing to the supposedly useless neighbours; their surprised faces are her favourite celebration. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie spielt nach vorn. Die Richtung wird nach dem Spiel beschlossen.

name: Bruno Beton
personality: He regards any change of direction as an attack on tradition.
visual_intent: Wide squat scalloped blob, low brows, asymmetric closed frown, small bandage on brow; tiny striped burgundy jersey front; goo hands stubbornly crossed with one muddy leather shin guard held against flank
biography: He regards any change of direction as an attack on tradition. He considers the courtyard an area that must be defended from new ideas. The battered shin guard is his portable boundary marker. A dissonant card suggesting that moving aside could help the team has become extremely difficult to tackle. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Er verteidigt den Bestand. Auch gegen die eigene Mannschaft.

name: Milla Mittendrin
personality: She can see every passing option except the one involving herself.
visual_intent: Tall narrow curved blob, questioning raised eyelid, tiny toothless sideways mouth; cream headband and burgundy knit collar; holds a folded miniature tactics board showing only three blank cream circles
biography: She can see every passing option except the one involving herself. Her three circles once represented the only acceptable social positions: useful, waiting and in the way. After a stranger passed her a dissonant card, she began moving the circles until everyone had someone nearby. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie verteilt das Spiel. Sich selbst hat sie auf dem Zettel vergessen.

name: Fips Flügelwind
personality: He is quick enough to outrun the plan and slow enough to explain why.
visual_intent: Leaning teardrop splat still upright, one spiral ink crest, mischievous uneven closed smirk; short burgundy neckerchief and one cream shoulder stripe; holds a single old leather boot by its laces as a cherished lucky charm, no feet
biography: He is quick enough to outrun the plan and slow enough to explain why. He delivers approved announcements along the corridors and believes a plan is either fast or disloyal. The lucky boot contains no foot and, increasingly, no evidence that speed is a moral quality. He still carries messages for slow neighbours. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Schuh bringt Glück. Laufen muss weiterhin jemand anders.

name: Kapitän Nachpfiff
personality: He keeps adding injury time to conversations nobody wants to finish.
visual_intent: Round broad blob, weary half-lidded eyes, long toothless exhale, one heavy filled lower lip; cream captain armband on goo arm and short burgundy collar; holds a squat old brass stopwatch
biography: He keeps adding injury time to conversations nobody wants to finish. He times corridor meetings with a brass stopwatch and classifies every resident as ready or delaying the team. One dissonant card asked whether a pause could be part of play. He has not stopped thinking about it, officially. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Nachspielzeit dauert an. Es wurden weitere Wortmeldungen verletzt.
